data.narrative:
Firehawk Aerospace is a Series A defense and security company that has raised $25M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 same-sector peers at Series A and adjacent stages, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Singularity.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $25M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yielding $50M. Peer-median analysis examines the 10-company comparable set, which spans $125M to $3.0B in valuation; the cohort median stands at $1.0B, with representative peers Dream Security ($3.0B Series B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B Series B), and Code Metal ($1.2B Series B) anchoring the upper end.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $42.5M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $525M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around near-term revenue trajectory and defensibility relative to well-capitalized competitors. The stage-progression method produces a conservative floor; peer multiples suggest considerably higher valuations are supported by market comps, though realization depends on product differentiation, customer traction, and capital efficiency relative to the peer set.
